sloka: यस्त्वा सम्चोदयति मे वच आच्चिद्य राघव ।गच्छेदानीम् महाबाहो क्षेमेण पुनरागतः ॥२-२४-३५॥
transliteration: yastvā samcodayati me vaca āccidya rāghava ।gacchedānīm mahābāho kṣemeṇa punarāgataḥ ॥2-24-35॥

translations.english: O Rama inconceivable is the course of destiny which is inciting you to go to the forest disregarding my words.
